reviews.text: Excellent place for pets, top-notch service and they treat the dogs wonderfully.

Good vet with good prices. Until… they're changing management and everything: closed several times, no phone service, they couldn't vaccinate my pet because they didn't have a vet, another time I went back three times because they didn't have anyone to see me. Apparently, the vet is moving to another city. I hope this is just a transition and things will either return or improve.

I highly recommend this place for bathing my dog. From the moment we arrived, they treated us with such kindness and patience. You can tell how much love and care they put into their work with pets. My dog ​​came out clean, happy, smelling wonderful, and very calm, which is very important to me. The service was excellent, and the place was very clean and pleasant. I will definitely continue taking him there. Thank you so much for taking such good care of our furry friends!
